topThreats.title: Hackers exploit Cisco SD-WAN flaw to deploy custom KeyDrift malware
topThreats.summary: A newly identified advanced persistent threat (APT) group tracked as UAT-11473 was observed exploiting CVE-2026-20127, an authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controllers, to deploy a custom malware framework called KeyDrift. [...]
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Evaluate organizational exposure against NIST CSF 2.0 governance metrics. Task Execution: Verify endpoint telemetry in SIEM, apply vendor security mitigations, and cross-reference internal asset databases.
